## applications (`/api/ui/applications`)

Application definitions — the root entity. Contains app name, code, type, default/shell/login pages, themes, styles, icon packs, font packs, manifest, and CSP settings.

**CRUD pattern:** `mongo_crud`
  - `POST /api/ui/applications/` — Create new entity
  - `GET /api/ui/applications/{id}` — Get entity by ID
  - `GET /api/ui/applications/` — List entities with pagination — params: eager: boolean — include related entities (default false), clientOnly: boolean — filter to current client only (default false), page: int (default 0), size: int (default 10)
  - `PUT /api/ui/applications/{id}` — Full update — replaces entity
  - `DELETE /api/ui/applications/{id}` — Delete entity by ID

**Schema fields:**
  - `name`: string — application display name
  - `appCode`: string — unique app code
  - `clientCode`: string — owning client code
  - `appType`: string — APP or SITE
  - `properties` (object):
    - `title`: string — browser tab title
    - `defaultPage`: string — page name shown after login
    - `shellPage`: string — layout wrapper page (optional)
    - `loginPage`: string — login page name (optional)
    - `forbiddenPage`: string — 403 page name (optional)
    - `iconPacks`: array — icon library names (e.g. fa-solid, fa-brands)
    - `fontPacks`: array — [{name, url}] for Google Fonts
    - `links`: array — [{rel, href}] for favicon etc.
    - `manifest`: object — PWA manifest {name, short_name, theme_color, display}
    - `csp`: object — Content Security Policy directives
    - `themes`: array — theme names to include
    - `styles`: array — style names to include

**Custom endpoints:**
  - `GET /api/ui/applications/{appCode}/mobileApps?clientCode=string` — List mobile apps for an application

# structure  (02-structure.md)

# Application and Page Structure

## Application Definition

Fetched via `GET /api/ui/application`. Key fields:

```typescript
{
  _id: string,           // MongoDB ID (used by UI tools)
  name: string,          // App name
  appCode: string,       // Unique code
  clientCode: string,    // Client code
  properties: {
    title?: string,
    defaultPage?: string,    // Home page name
    shellPage?: string,      // Shell wrapper page
    loginPage?: string,
    forbiddenPage?: string,
    notFoundPage?: string,
    signUp?: string,
    forgotPasswordPage?: string,
    termsConditionPage?: string,
    privacyPolicyPage?: string,
    defaultLanguage?: string,

    // Head injection
    links?: { [key: string]: { rel, href, type? } },
    scripts?: { [key: string]: { src, async?, defer? } },
    metas?: { [key: string]: { name?, content } },

    // Font and icon packs
    fontPacks?: { [key: string]: { name, code, order? } },
    iconPacks?: { [key: string]: { name } },  // e.g. "FREE_FONT_AWESOME_ALL"

    // Theme and style references
    themes?: { [key: string]: { name: string } },
    styles?: { [key: string]: { name: string } },

    // Global variables
    fillerValues?: { [key: string]: any },
  }
}
```

Shell page wraps all content pages (nav, header, footer). Pages with `wrapShell: true` (default) load inside the shell.

## Page Definition

Fetched via `GET /api/ui/page/{pageName}`. Key fields:

```typescript
{
  _id: string,
  name: string,          // Page name (used in URLs)
  appCode: string,
  clientCode: string,
  rootComponent: string, // Key into componentDefinition (STRING, not object)

  componentDefinition: {
    [key: string]: {
      key: string,
      name?: string,
      type: string,        // Component type (Grid, Button, etc.)
      properties?: { [propName: string]: ComponentProperty },
      styleProperties?: ComponentStyle,
      children?: { [childKey: string]: boolean },
      displayOrder?: number,
      bindingPath?: DataLocation,
      validations?: Array<Validation>,
    }
  },

  eventFunctions: {
    [key: string]: FunctionDefinition  // KIRun functions
  },

  properties: {
    title?: { name?: ComponentProperty, append?: ComponentProperty },
    onLoadEvent?: string,         // Event key to run on load
    loadStrategy?: "default" | "always" | "once",
    wrapShell?: boolean,
    storeInitialization?: { [path: string]: any },
    seo?: { description?, keywords?, robots?, author? },
    classes?: { [key: string]: StyleClassDefinition },
  },

  translations?: { [lang: string]: { [key: string]: string } },
}
```

## ComponentProperty

```typescript
interface ComponentProperty<T> {
  value?: T,                // Static value
  location?: DataLocation,  // Dynamic value
}

interface DataLocation {
  type: "VALUE" | "EXPRESSION",
  value?: string,       // Store path for VALUE type
  expression?: string,  // Expression for EXPRESSION type
}
```

Resolution priority: `location` (if resolves) → `value` (fallback)

Expressions can reference: `Store.x`, `Page.x`, `Url.x`, `Theme.x`, `Filler.x`, `Parent.x`, `LocalStore.x`

## Data Binding

Components can have `bindingPath` through `bindingPath10` (DataLocation objects) providing data context.

**ArrayRepeater** uses `bindingPath` to iterate arrays. Child components access current item via `Parent.` prefix:

```json
{
  "type": "ArrayRepeater",
  "bindingPath": {"type": "VALUE", "value": "Store.items"},
  "children": {"itemCard": true}
}
```

Inside `itemCard`, use `Parent.name`, `Parent.price` etc. to access item fields.

## Children Ordering

Children are sorted by: 1) `displayOrder` (ascending), 2) `key` (alphabetical).

## Schema Definitions

Used for function parameters, data validation, and form generation:

```json
{
  "definition": {
    "name": "Product", "namespace": "Store",
    "type": ["OBJECT"],
    "properties": {
      "name": {"type": "STRING", "minLength": 1},
      "price": {"type": "DOUBLE", "minimum": 0}
    },
    "required": ["name", "price"]
  }
}
```

Types: `INTEGER`, `LONG`, `FLOAT`, `DOUBLE`, `STRING`, `OBJECT`, `ARRAY`, `BOOLEAN`, `NULL`
String formats: `DATETIME`, `TIME`, `DATE`, `EMAIL`, `REGEX`

payload.summary:
## rolev2 (`/api/security/rolev2`)

Role definitions — named groups of permissions within an application. Roles form a hierarchy: a parent role can have sub-roles. Each role contains permissions (authorities) that grant access to specific API operations. Roles are assigned to users either directly or via Profiles (preferred). The authority string format is the permission name, which becomes 'Authorities.APPCODE.PermissionName' in the JWT token for app-scoped access.

**CRUD pattern:** `jooq_crud`
  - `POST /api/security/rolev2/` — Create new entity
  - `GET /api/security/rolev2/{id}` — Get entity by ID
  - `GET /api/security/rolev2/` — List with pagination and filter params — params: page: int (default 0), size: int (default 10), sort: field,direction (e.g. 'updatedAt,desc')
  - `POST /api/security/rolev2/query` — Advanced filtering with condition object
  - `PUT /api/security/rolev2/{id}` — Full update
  - `PATCH /api/security/rolev2/{id}` — Partial update — only provided fields changed
  - `DELETE /api/security/rolev2/{id}` — Delete entity

**Schema fields:**
  - `clientId`: ULong — owning client ID
  - `appId`: ULong — application this role belongs to
  - `appName`: string — app name (read-only, derived)
  - `name`: string — role display name
  - `shortName`: string — abbreviated name
  - `description`: string — role description
  - `authority`: string — the authority string for this role
  - `parentRoleId`: ULong — parent role for hierarchy (null = top-level)
  - `subRoles`: List<RoleV2> — child roles (read-only, eager-loaded)
  - `app`: App — application details (read-only, eager-loaded)
  - `permissions`: List<Permission> — permissions in this role (write-only in JSON)

**Custom endpoints:**
  - `GET /api/security/rolev2/assignable/{appCode}` — Get all roles assignable within an app — combines RoleV2 records and roles from Profile assignments. Used to populate role picker dropdowns

**Query object format** (for POST /query):
  - `condition`: AbstractCondition — nested filter conditions
  - `page`: int (default 0)
  - `size`: int (default 10)
  - `sort`: {"orders": [{"property": "fieldName", "direction": "ASC|DESC"}]}
  - `fields`: array of field names to include
  - `excludeFields`: boolean — if true, fields list is exclusion list

## profiles (`/api/security/app`)

Profiles — collections of roles that simplify permission assignment. Instead of assigning individual roles to users, assign a Profile that bundles multiple roles. Profiles are scoped to an application. A profile can be the 'defaultProfile' assigned automatically to new users. Profiles can be restricted to specific clients within the hierarchy. The 'arrangement' field stores UI layout preferences for the profile (e.g. sidebar structure).

**Schema fields:**
  - `appId`: ULong — application this profile belongs to
  - `clientId`: ULong — owning client ID
  - `name`: string — profile name
  - `title`: string — display title
  - `description`: string — profile description
  - `defaultProfile`: boolean — if true, auto-assigned to new users in this app
  - `rootProfileId`: ULong — ID of the root/parent profile (for profile inheritance)
  - `arrangement`: Map<String, Object> — UI layout configuration (sidebar, menu structure)

**Custom endpoints:**
  - `POST /api/security/app/profiles` — Create a new profile with selected roles — body: {name: string, title: string, description: string, appId: ULong, roleIds: [ULong]}
  - `PUT /api/security/app/profiles` — Update a profile — can change roles, name, description — body: {id: ULong, name: string, title: string, description: string, appId: ULong, roleIds: [ULong]}
  - `GET /api/security/app/profiles/{id}` — Get profile by ID with role details
  - `DELETE /api/security/app/profiles/{id}` — Delete a profile — removes profile assignments from all users
  - `GET /api/security/app/{appId}/profiles?page=int&size=int` — List profiles for an application (paginated)
  - `POST /api/security/app/profiles/{id}/restrictClient/{clientId}` — Restrict profile visibility to a specific client — only users of that client can be assigned this profile
